input_policy: Raw43200 one-minute historical values only; no future values/predicted T/calendar; no patches or downsampling
task: Past 30 days of noisy simulated temperature plus seven deflections -> 24h joint eight-channel forecast
test_policy: Evaluate after validation-selected checkpoint; no configuration search.
normalization_policy: Eight channels fitted on first280-day valid simulated observations only
loss_policy: Observed-entry masked standardized MSE across eight channels; derivative weights remain zero
forecast_target_policy: Future temperature and seven deflections are labels only
training_origin_policy: 499 train origins, startsday30, same expanded coverage as vd2.1-2 temperature
model_definition: Official original Mamba1 blocks, pre-norm residual stack, input Linear and last-state direct horizon Linear; no graph/frequency/ODE additions
initialization_policy: Preserve official Mamba initialization; zero only forecasting output Linear
